one_liner: Product analytics for early-stage SaaS: auto-captured funnels you can read in minutes, hosted in the EU.
description: funnelscope gives small SaaS teams working funnels without an analytics engineer. Events are auto-captured from a lightweight snippet, funnels are assembled by pointing at UI elements rather than writing SQL, and all data stays on EU servers for GDPR peace of mind. It deliberately ships a fraction of Mixpanel's surface area so a founder can answer 'where do signups drop off' in one sitting.
target_user: Founders and PMs at pre-Series-A SaaS companies

icp.who: Technical founders at 2-15 person SaaS companies without a data hire
icp.pain: Mixpanel and Amplitude require an instrumentation project and a learning curve nobody has time for, so analytics never gets set up properly
icp.buying_trigger: Preparing an investor update or pricing change and realizing nobody actually knows the activation funnel numbers

differentiators: Median time from snippet install to first working funnel is 6 minutes
Auto-capture plus point-and-click funnel definition — no tracking plan or SQL required
EU-only data residency by default, not as an enterprise add-on
proof_points: Median time-to-first-funnel of 6 minutes measured across beta cohort
All data processed and stored in EU (Frankfurt) with a signed DPA available on request

voice.sample_phrase: Know where signups drop off before your next investor update.

signals: Pricing page live but billed usage waived during beta

gaps: No case studies or named customers
No comparison pages against Mixpanel or PostHog
No API or data export yet

confidence.notes: Product claims consistent across site and changelog. Workspace counts are self-reported beta metrics.
